note: Both sets capture the same core facts faithfully: material properties from Table 4-1, the 0.170 Hz first tower-monopile mode, the 0.10–0.13 Hz wave range for the generic East Coast site, 150 m hub height, 120-m blades, 30 m clearance, 10-m monopile outer diameter, and the 100 t transition piece.
